title: Hanford complete material balance receives attributable fork evidence without automatic blame
summary: Conflicting checkpoints are preserved and independently observed, technically attributed to a log key and endpoint, and quarantined; the receipt never assigns human blame, publishes, closes a hold, or creates source evidence automatically.
